Ligue Magnus competitions (one per season)

Source: R/magnus.R
magnus_competitions.Rd

Competitions of a competition type from liguemagnus.com (get_competition_by_type): one row per season, with the competition_id the other routes key a season by. Coverage starts in 2020-21.

Usage

magnus_competitions(competition_type = 1, return_parsed = TRUE)

Arguments

competition_type

Competition type: 1 = Ligue Magnus (default), 2 = Division 1.

return_parsed

Parse the payload into a tibble (default TRUE). Pass FALSE for the raw JSON envelope as a list.

Value

A tibble (return_parsed = TRUE), else the raw envelope list:

col_nametypedescription
competition_idintegerLigue Magnus competition id (integer); one per season, the key get_phases and get_rencontres take (1 = 2020-21 ... 240 = 2026-27).
seasonintegerSeason by its END year (2027 = 2026-27), the federation's saison field.
competitioncharacterCompetition name as published (sponsor name included, e.g., "Synerglace Ligue Magnus").
competition_type_idintegerCompetition type id: 1 = Ligue Magnus, 2 = Division 1.
competition_type_codecharacterCompetition type code (NA for the Ligue Magnus).
competition_typecharacterCompetition type label (e.g., "Ligue Magnus").
external_urlcharacterExternal site linked from the competition (streaming partner).
publishedlogicalWhether the competition is published on the league site.

Errors

fastRhockey_no_data: success = false with "Aucune donnee disponible", an empty data stub, zero rows, a season outside 2020-21 onwards, an unknown or unplayed game. fastRhockey_asset_fetch: a failed fetch, success = false with any other message, rows outside the requested scope, a partial schedule page, or a game page without its embedded game sheet. fastRhockey_bad_request: HTTP 400/422, a validation error naming a rejected parameter, or an invalid argument.

See also

Other Ligue Magnus Functions: magnus_game(), magnus_lineups(), magnus_pbp(), magnus_phases(), magnus_round_games(), magnus_rounds(), magnus_schedule(), magnus_shootout(), magnus_standings(), magnus_teams()

Examples

# \donttest{
  try(magnus_competitions())
#> ── Ligue Magnus Competitions Information from liguemagnus.com ──────────────────
#> ℹ Data updated: 2026-10-30 00:17:06 UTC
#> # A tibble: 7 × 8
#>   competition_id season competition    competition_type_id competition_type_code
#>            <int>  <int> <chr>                        <int> <chr>                
#> 1              1   2021 Synerglace Li…                   1 NA                   
#> 2             34   2022 Synerglace Li…                   1 NA                   
#> 3             79   2023 Synerglace li…                   1 NA                   
#> 4            120   2024 Synerglace Li…                   1 NA                   
#> 5            157   2025 Synerglace Li…                   1 NA                   
#> 6            197   2026 Synerglace Li…                   1 NA                   
#> 7            240   2027 Synerglace Li…                   1 NA                   
#> # ℹ 3 more variables: competition_type <chr>, external_url <chr>,
#> #   published <lgl>
# }
